scope: Read-only original Owner case status and lease counts; no model or mutation
query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'observedAt', clock_timestamp(),
  'tasks', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',t.id,'ownerId',t."userId",'issueId',t."issueId",'stage',t.stage,'status',t.status,
    'revision',t.revision,'candidateId',t."candidateId",'updatedAt',t."updatedAt",
    'runStatusCounts',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(status,n),'{}'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT status,count(*) n FROM agent_runs r WHERE r."userId"=t."userId" AND r."issueId"=t."issueId" GROUP BY status) s),
    'unexpiredRunLeases',(SELECT count(*) FROM agent_runs r WHERE r."userId"=t."userId" AND r."issueId"=t."issueId" AND r."leaseExpiresAt">now())
  ) ORDER BY t.id),'[]'::jsonb)
) AS observation
FROM factory_tasks t
WHERE t."userId"='XjTsvV1ASqtV8wWat9aco0Z0KLodd9jJ'
  AND t.id=ANY(ARRAY['6e413ef7-7179-442d-ad0e-b9492cf76145','9ea956ce-a604-4c2e-a724-fb04fa5a3c9b']::uuid[])
